ticker: Eisenkot tasked with forming new Israeli government
Egypt train collision leaves 7 dead and dozens injured
Anthropic secures $3.4B AI data center generator deal
Power restored to Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant, IAEA confirms
Pakistan beats India in U-19 Asia Cup thriller

articles.headline: Israeli President Tasks Gadi Eisenkot to Form Government
articles.brief: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has assigned Netanyahu rival Gadi Eisenkot the responsibility of forming the next government. Eisenkot secured recommendations from 67 lawmakers but faces uphill coalition-building challenges.

articles.headline: Egypt Train Collision Kills at Least Seven People
articles.brief: A tragic train collision in Egypt has killed at least seven people and injured over a hundred others. The railway authority reported that a regional service crashed into the rear of a stationary passenger train.

articles.headline: Anthropic Secures $3.4 Billion Generator Deal for AI
articles.brief: Anthropic has reportedly secured a massive $3.4 billion generator deal to power its growing network of energy-intensive AI data centers, according to Financial Times reports.

articles.headline: Trump Says Iran Strikes Unlikely If Diplomacy Progresses
articles.brief: Former U.S. President Donald Trump stated that ordering fresh military strikes against Iran is highly unlikely, provided current nuclear negotiations and regional diplomatic efforts continue to show positive progress.

articles.headline: Power Restored to Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Plant, IAEA Says
articles.brief: The International Atomic Energy Agency confirmed that external power has been successfully restored to the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant following recent disruptions that heightened safety concerns at the facility.

articles.headline: Europeans to Join Ukraine Talks in Abu Dhabi
articles.brief: European diplomats are set to participate in upcoming Ukraine peace and security talks hosted in Abu Dhabi, aiming to coordinate diplomatic strategies with international partners, according to the French foreign minister.

articles.headline: Production Suspended at Iraq Khor Mor Field After Attack
articles.brief: Gas production at Iraq's Khor Mor field has been suspended following a drone attack that struck a storage facility. Crews were ordered into shelters as precautionary security measures were implemented.

articles.headline: Pakistan Defeats India by Three Wickets in U-19 Asia Cup
articles.brief: Pakistan's under-19 cricket team secured a narrow three-wicket victory over arch-rivals India in a competitive encounter during the ongoing youth regional tournament.

articles.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Admits Affair, Board Orders Review
articles.brief: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang publicly disclosed an extramarital affair with a Singapore-based CEO. The company's board has launched an independent security review over potential national security vulnerabilities.

articles.headline: Indian Shares Consolidate in Special Diwali Session
articles.brief: Indian benchmark equity indices consolidated during the festive Diwali trading session, pausing slightly after posting a strong seven-session consecutive winning streak.

articles.headline: RBI Clarifies No New Checkbook Rules in January
articles.brief: The Reserve Bank of India has officially rejected viral market rumors, confirming that no new operational guidelines or sweeping changes to checkbook rules will take effect in January.

articles.headline: Tens of Thousands March in Amsterdam Over Gaza War
articles.brief: A massive 'Red Line' demonstration brought central Amsterdam to a standstill as tens of thousands of protesters demanded that the Dutch government enforce stricter trade sanctions and halt arms sales to Israel.
